input.quote: 5.9.3 If Harpoon or any of its Affiliates, after the Effective Date, become a party to a license, sublicense or other agreement for [***], or as permitted in Sections 5.9.1 or 5.9.2, then Harpoon shall inform AbbVie and shall provide AbbVie with a copy of such license, sublicense, or other agreement ("Proposed Future In-Licensed Rights").
input.rationale: Searches for MFN-type language ("most favored/favoured", "favorable/favourable", "no less favorable", "comparable terms", "match", "terms at least as") returned no hits, and the two areas where such a term would sit (Article 6 payments and Section 5.9 In-License Agreements) contain none. Section 5.9 works in our favour: Harpoon is restricted from entering third-party IP agreements without our consent (5.9.1), AbbVie has the first right to negotiate third-party licenses (5.9.2), and Harpoon must notify us of and offer us the benefit of future in-licensed rights, which we may elect to take (5.9.3). No provision obliges AbbVie to extend Harpoon terms no less favourable than those given to any third party or to match third-party offers. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer); nothing to redline.
